Path: views to see the data | records-forms.grid-personalization | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue`. Each save is built from the row the last save left, not from the page-load row

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-05T04:51Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` (`persistViewPatch` / `buildPersistedViewBody`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: every whole-document PUT starts from a stale base, so the second change silently drops the first.

- **Why p2.** Same class and grade as objectui#11625. The user's earlier choice is acknowledged and then lost with no error, here after any second toolbar change.
- **Direction.** After a successful write, the base for the next write is the row that write stored, on every row kind (envelope row, flat row, overlay). Two changes in one session then compose.
  - ⛔ No client-side merge of guessed fields. The base is the stored row.
- **Pins:** the card's Done-when (two changes to one view both survive a reload), for each row kind.
- **Serial:** objectui#11625 is in flight on the same function (PR objectui#11639). This card starts after it lands.

The in-flight objectui#11626 declares `packages/layout` and `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`.

Why `Clause-②: no`: `persistViewPatch` is internal, and `buildPersistedViewBody` is not exported from the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry. The fix changes which row the next save starts from, so nothing in the published accept set or public surface widens. The dispatch fences any new export, prop, type member or i18n key: a route that needs one stops and reports.

## ACCEPT: PR objectui#11646, head `5af8b90`. It lands when every check on this head is green

`domain:ui` execution seat 1 @ objectui · `session_015W8GBu6sBiqus2L2xjMsAL` (`os-steve`) · 2026-10-05T07:36Z. Reviewed against GitHub and `origin/main`, not against the report's prose (report `5990133081`).

- **Shape.** The PR is a draft against `main`, and its assignee is `os-steve`. Its first line is `Fixes #11642`, the only line with a closing keyword next to an issue number. `Clause-②: no` is on its own line. Against `main` the diff is 3 files, +571/−32, inside the claim's surface: `ObjectView.tsx`, one pin file and the changeset.
- **The base is the stored row, as ruled, and it is not guessed.** The dev measured that the `PUT` answer carries no row and that the door drops undeclared keys, so the body sent is not the stored row. Each toolbar save therefore reads the stored row when it runs, through the same `loadViewOverrides` list read the page load uses. Saves to one view are chained, so an in-flight save is never read past. An overlay joins its stored owned keys (`VIEW_OVERLAY_OWNED_KEYS`) with the patch, so objectui#5233's no-frozen-copy rule holds. The 300 ms debounce still coalesces.
- **objectui#11625's pins are untouched and green.** `densityInsideConfig-11625` and `overlayPatchOnly` both pass at this head, and ablation A left them green.
- **Tests.** The new pin mounts the real object page over the real adapter, on a store that judges each `PUT` with `ViewMetadataSchema`. It covers the Done-when per row kind (envelope, flat, overlay), debounce coalescing, and a save landing mid-flight. Ablation A (the pre-fix base) turns the 3 row-kind cases and the in-flight case red. Ablation B (no chain) turns only the in-flight case red. The whole `app-shell` suite is green (1003 files). The `writeRefusalCensus-11583` ledger was kept intact, caught and fixed on the way.
- **Live, both directions** (objectstack `main` `a3ffc451`). Before: density then a header sort kept only the sort, on the envelope, flat and overlay rows. After: both survive a reload on all three, and two changes 100 ms apart are one `PUT` carrying both.
- **Consequences beyond the card, stated in the PR body, accepted.**
  - The first toolbar save now starts from the stored row, not the page-load tab, so it no longer stamps the tab's `isDefault` onto the row.
  - In `?preview=draft`, a toolbar save no longer builds the row from a draft-merged tab. That is NOT MEASURED live; it is the direction the ruling's "the base is the stored row" implies.
- **Changeset, sentence by sentence.** It is `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`. The mechanism, the source of the stored row, the overlay rule, the chaining and the debounce sentences all match the diff. The `Clause-②: no` line is true.

**Left as noted, not filed:** a flat `_isOverride` overlay reached by a direct `PUT` shadows the served view's filter. It is the same finding as at PR objectui#11639's review: still no console reach from a clean state. Also, `updateViewConfig`'s doc promises a returned item the door never sends; its one caller ignores it.

Landing: on all-green checks on this head, ready, then auto-merge into the merge queue. objectui#11643 is held serially behind this card (same save path) and is dispatched once this lands.
